issues.description: The knowledge-import acceptance criteria explicitly include reading build.zig.zon for Zig 0.16 alignment after importing context, but build.zig.zon still declares `.minimum_zig_version = "0.15.2"`. This leaves the imported Zig 0.16 guidance misaligned with repo-facing toolchain metadata, so the feature does not fully satisfy its expected behavior as reviewed from the committed diff.

The skill should distinguish documentation/knowledge-import tasks from runtime-migration tasks so workers do not appear to deviate when baseline blockers are unrelated.
